label: DRT3 system
definition: A DRT system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder DRT_3 subtype locus represented by the mandatory DRT_3__drt3a and DRT_3__drt3b profiles.
observations: DRT3 branch under DRT system; distinct from the broader DRT system, the individual DRT3 reverse-transcriptase profile rows, unresolved DRT3 phage triggers, direct RT products, host breadth, partner features, the DRT_3__SLATT inventory row, and other DRT subtypes.
